9:7.web: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
9:7.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

bsb: they led him by the hand
9:8.web: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
9:8.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

9:9.web: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
9:9.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

9:10.web: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
9:10.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

9:11.web: The Lord said to him, “Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
9:11.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

9:12.web: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
9:12.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

9:13.web: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
9:13.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

9:14.web: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
9:14.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

9:15.web: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
9:15.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

9:16.web: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
9:16.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.

9:17.web: Ananias departed, and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me, that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
9:17.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

9:18.web: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
9:18.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

9:19.web: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
9:19.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

9:20.web: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
9:20.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

9:21.web: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
9:21.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

9:22.web: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
9:22.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

9:23.web: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
9:23.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

9:24.web: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
9:24.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

9:25.web: but his disciples took him by night, and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
9:25.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

9:26.web: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
9:26.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

9:27.web: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
9:27.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

9:28.web: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
9:28.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

9:29.web: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
9:29.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

9:30.web: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him off to Tarsus.
9:30.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

9:31.web: So the assemblies throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
9:31.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

9:32.web: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
9:32.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

9:33.web: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
9:33.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

9:34.web: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
9:34.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

9:35.web: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
9:35.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

9:36.web: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated, means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
9:36.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

9:37.web: In those days, she became sick, and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
9:37.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

9:38.web: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
9:38.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

9:39.web: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
9:39.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

9:40.web: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
9:40.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

9:41.web: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
9:41.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

9:42.web: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
9:42.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

9:43.web: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
9:43.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

10:1.web: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
10:1.kjv: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

10:2.web: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
10:2.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

10:3.web: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
10:3.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

10:4.web: He, fastening his eyes on him, and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
10:4.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

10:5.web: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
10:5.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

10:6.web: He lodges with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
10:6.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

10:7.web: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
10:7.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

10:8.web: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
10:8.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

10:9.web: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
10:9.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

10:10.web: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
10:10.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

10:11.web: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
10:11.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

10:12.web: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
10:12.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

10:13.web: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
10:13.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

10:14.web: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
10:14.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

10:15.web: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
10:15.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

10:16.web: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.
10:16.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

10:17.web: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
10:17.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,

10:18.web: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
10:18.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

10:19.web: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
10:19.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

10:20.web: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
10:20.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

10:21.web: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
10:21.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

10:22.web: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
10:22.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

10:23.web: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
10:23.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

10:24.web: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
10:24.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

10:25.web: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
10:25.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

10:26.web: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
10:26.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

10:27.web: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
10:27.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

10:28.web: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
10:28.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

10:29.web: Therefore also I came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
10:29.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

10:30.web: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
10:30.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

10:31.web: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
10:31.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

10:32.web: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He lodges in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
10:32.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

10:33.web: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
10:33.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

10:34.web: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
10:34.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

10:35.web: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
10:35.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

10:36.web: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
10:36.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

10:37.web: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
10:37.kjv: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

10:38.web: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
10:38.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

10:39.web: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
10:39.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

10:40.web: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,
10:40.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

10:41.web: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
10:41.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

10:42.web: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
10:42.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

10:43.web: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
10:43.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

10:44.web: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
10:44.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

10:45.web: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
10:45.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

10:46.web: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
10:46.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

10:47.web: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
10:47.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

10:48.web: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
10:48.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

11:1.web: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
11:1.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

11:2.web: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
11:2.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

11:3.web: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!”
11:3.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

11:4.web: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
11:4.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

11:5.web: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
11:5.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

11:6.web: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
11:6.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

11:7.web: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
11:7.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

11:8.web: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
11:8.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

11:9.web: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
11:9.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

11:10.web: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
11:10.kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

11:11.web: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
11:11.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

11:12.web: The Spirit told me to go with them, without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
11:12.kjv: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:

11:13.web: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa, and get Simon, who is called Peter,
11:13.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

11:14.web: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
11:14.kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

11:15.web: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
11:15.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

11:16.web: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
11:16.kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

11:17.web: If then God gave to them the same gift as us, when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
11:17.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

11:18.web: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
11:18.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

11:19.web: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
11:19.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

11:20.web: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
11:20.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

11:21.web: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
11:21.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

11:22.web: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
11:22.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

11:23.web: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
11:23.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

11:24.web: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
11:24.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

11:25.web: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
11:25.kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

11:26.web: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
11:26.kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

11:27.web: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
11:27.kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

11:28.web: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
11:28.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

11:29.web: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
11:29.kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

11:30.web: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
11:30.kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

12:1.web: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
12:1.kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

12:2.web: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
12:2.kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

12:3.web: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
12:3.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

12:4.web: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
12:4.kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

12:5.web: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
12:5.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

12:6.web: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
12:6.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

12:7.web: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side, and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off from his hands.
12:7.kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

12:8.web: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak, and follow me.”
12:8.kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

12:9.web: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
12:9.kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

12:10.web: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out, and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
12:10.kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

12:11.web: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
12:11.kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

12:12.web: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
12:12.kjv: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

12:13.web: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a maid named Rhoda came to answer.
12:13.kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

12:14.web: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in, and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
12:14.kjv: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

bsb: You are out of your mind,”
12:15.web: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
12:15.kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

12:16.web: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.
12:16.kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

12:17.web: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James, and to the brothers.” Then he departed, and went to another place.
12:17.kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

12:18.web: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
12:18.kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

12:19.web: When Herod had sought for him, and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
12:19.kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.

12:20.web: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
12:20.kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.

12:21.web: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
12:21.kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

12:22.web: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
12:22.kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

12:23.web: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.
12:23.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

12:24.web: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
12:24.kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

12:25.web: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
12:25.kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

13:1.web: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
13:1.kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

13:2.web: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
13:2.kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

13:3.web: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
13:3.kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

13:4.kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

13:5.web: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They had also John as their attendant.
13:5.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

13:6.web: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,
13:6.kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:

13:7.web: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
13:7.kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

13:8.web: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
13:8.kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

13:9.web: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,
13:9.kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,

13:10.web: and said, “Full of all deceit and all cunning, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
13:10.kjv: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

bsb: someone to lead him by the hand.
13:11.web: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
13:11.kjv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

13:12.web: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
13:12.kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

13:13.web: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
13:13.kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

13:14.web: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.
13:14.kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

13:15.web: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
13:15.kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

13:16.web: Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
13:16.kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

bsb: He made them into a great
13:17.web: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
13:17.kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

13:18.web: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
13:18.kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

bsb: to His people as an inheritance.
13:19.web: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.
13:19.kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

13:20.web: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
13:20.kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

13:21.web: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
13:21.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

13:22.web: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
13:22.kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

13:23.web: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
13:23.kjv: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

13:24.web: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
13:24.kjv: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

13:25.web: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
13:25.kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

13:26.web: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
13:26.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

13:27.web: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
13:27.kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

13:28.web: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
13:28.kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

13:29.web: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.
13:29.kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

13:30.web: But God raised him from the dead,
13:30.kjv: But God raised him from the dead:

13:31.web: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
13:31.kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

bsb: proclaim to you the good news:
13:32.web: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
13:32.kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

13:33.web: that God has fulfilled the same to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
13:33.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

13:34.web: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
13:34.kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

13:35.web: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
13:35.kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

13:36.web: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, and was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
13:36.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

13:37.web: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
13:37.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

13:38.web: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins,
13:38.kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

13:39.web: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
13:39.kjv: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

13:40.web: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
13:40.kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

13:41.web: ‘Behold, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish; for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
13:41.kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

13:42.web: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
13:42.kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

13:43.web: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
13:43.kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

13:44.web: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
13:44.kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

13:45.web: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
13:45.kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

13:46.web: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
13:46.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

13:47.web: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
13:47.kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

13:48.web: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
13:48.kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

13:49.web: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
13:49.kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

13:50.web: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
13:50.kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

13:51.web: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
13:51.kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

13:52.web: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
13:52.kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

14:1.web: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
14:1.kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

14:2.web: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
14:2.kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

14:3.web: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
14:3.kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

14:4.web: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
14:4.kjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

14:5.web: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
14:5.kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

14:6.web: they became aware of it, and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
14:6.kjv: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

14:7.web: There they preached the Good News.
14:7.kjv: And there they preached the gospel.

14:8.web: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
14:8.kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:

14:9.web: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
14:9.kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

14:10.web: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
14:10.kjv: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

14:11.web: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”
14:11.kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

14:12.web: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
14:12.kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

14:13.web: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.
14:13.kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

14:14.web: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes, and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
14:14.kjv: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

bsb: We are bringing you good news
14:15.web: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
14:15.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

14:16.web: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
14:16.kjv: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

14:17.web: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
14:17.kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

bsb: Paul and Barnabas could hardly stop
14:18.web: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
14:18.kjv: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

14:19.web: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
14:19.kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

14:20.web: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
14:20.kjv: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

14:21.web: When they had preached the Good News to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
14:21.kjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

14:22.web: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
14:22.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

14:23.web: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.
14:23.kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

14:24.web: They passed through Pisidia, and came to Pamphylia.
14:24.kjv: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

14:25.web: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
14:25.kjv: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

14:26.web: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
14:26.kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

14:27.web: When they had arrived, and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.
14:27.kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

14:28.web: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
14:28.kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

15:1.web: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
15:1.kjv: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

15:2.web: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and some others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
15:2.kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

15:3.web: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
15:3.kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

15:4.web: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported all things that God had done with them.
15:4.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

15:5.web: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
15:5.kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

15:6.web: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
15:6.kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

15:7.web: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News, and believe.
15:7.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

15:8.web: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
15:8.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

15:9.web: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
15:9.kjv: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

15:10.web: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
15:10.kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

15:11.web: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
15:11.kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

15:12.web: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
15:12.kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

15:13.web: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
15:13.kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

15:14.web: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations, to take out of them a people for his name.
15:14.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

15:15.web: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
15:15.kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

15:16.web: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up,
15:16.kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

15:17.web: That the rest of men may seek after the Lord; all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.
15:17.kjv: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

15:18.web: All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.’
15:18.kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

bsb: that we should not cause trouble for
15:19.web: “Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
15:19.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

15:20.web: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
15:20.kjv: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

15:21.web: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
15:21.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

15:22.web: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
15:22.kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

15:23.web: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
15:23.kjv: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

bsb: It has come to our attention
15:24.web: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;
15:24.kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

15:25.web: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
15:25.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

15:26.web: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
15:26.kjv: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

15:27.web: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
15:27.kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

15:28.web: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
15:28.kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

bsb: from the meat of strangled animals,
15:29.web: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
15:29.kjv: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

15:30.web: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
15:30.kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

15:31.web: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
15:31.kjv: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

15:32.web: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words, and strengthened them.
15:32.kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

15:33.web: After they had spent some time there, they were sent back with greetings from the brothers to the apostles.
15:33.kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

15:34.kjv: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

15:35.web: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
15:35.kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

15:36.web: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
15:36.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

15:37.web: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
15:37.kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

15:38.web: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
15:38.kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

15:39.web: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away to Cyprus,
15:39.kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

15:40.web: but Paul chose Silas, and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
15:40.kjv: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

15:41.web: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
15:41.kjv: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

16:1.web: He came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed; but his father was a Greek.
16:1.kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

16:2.web: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
16:2.kjv: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

16:3.web: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts; for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
16:3.kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

16:4.web: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
16:4.kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

16:5.web: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
16:5.kjv: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

16:6.web: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
16:6.kjv: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

16:7.web: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
16:7.kjv: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

16:8.web: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
16:8.kjv: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

16:9.web: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him, and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
16:9.kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

16:10.web: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
16:10.kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

16:11.web: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
16:11.kjv: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

16:12.web: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
16:12.kjv: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

16:13.web: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down, and spoke to the women who had come together.
16:13.kjv: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

16:14.web: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us; whose heart the Lord opened to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.
16:14.kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

16:15.web: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and stay.” So she persuaded us.
16:15.kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

16:16.web: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.
16:16.kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

16:17.web: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
16:17.kjv: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

16:18.web: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
16:18.kjv: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

16:19.web: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
16:19.kjv: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

16:20.web: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city,
16:20.kjv: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

16:21.web: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
16:21.kjv: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

16:22.web: The multitude rose up together against them, and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, and commanded them to be beaten with rods.
16:22.kjv: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

16:23.web: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely,
16:23.kjv: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely:

16:24.web: who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.
16:24.kjv: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

16:25.web: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
16:25.kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

16:26.web: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
16:26.kjv: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.

16:27.web: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
16:27.kjv: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

16:28.web: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
16:28.kjv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

16:29.web: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
16:29.kjv: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

16:30.web: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
16:30.kjv: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

16:31.web: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
16:31.kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

16:32.web: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
16:32.kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

16:33.web: He took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.
16:33.kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

bsb: that they had come to believe
16:34.web: He brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his household, having believed in God.
16:34.kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

16:35.web: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
16:35.kjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

bsb: you may go on your way
